description: A Client Component ('use client') file convention that wraps a route segment or parallel slot in a React Error Boundary, receiving { error, reset } props.
The Next.js function and file convention used to abort rendering of a route segment when a requested entity does not exist, displaying a contextual 404 UI instead of an error boundary.
Placing separate error.tsx and not-found.tsx boundaries inside @slot directories so a failure in one dashboard panel leaves sibling panels mounted and interactive.
The root-level error boundary that catches errors thrown in the root app/layout.tsx and must define its own <html> and <body> tags.
